body.statement: Theorem 2 (Quadratic oracle complexity). If \(|V_0|=p\), RankPeel returns either \(\bot\) or a graph after at most \(p^2+p\) membership-and-rank calls to the law-invariant oracle, \(O(p^3)\) elementary bookkeeping, \(O(p^2)\) graph storage, and at most \(1+\lfloor\log_2 p\rfloor\) nonempty iterations. On the complete-run domain of Theorem 1, this is a strict query-complexity tightening of the exhaustive subset construction in Prashant et al. for the same identified adjacency target.
body.justification: The explicit budget isolates the algorithmic gain over exhaustive subset enumeration without claiming a stronger identified graph.
body.gap: The anchor identifies the same adjacency matrix but does not give a polynomial observed-query bound for its subset construction.
body.consumer: The bound fixes the complete family of population decisions that subsequent statistical calibration must cover simultaneously.
